name: vardoger
description: Personalizes your AI assistant by analyzing conversation history and generating tailored instructions. Runs entirely on your machine.

interface.shortDescription: Personalize your assistant from your own conversation history
interface.longDescription: Vardoger reads your Codex conversation history locally, extracts behavioral patterns, and generates a personalized AGENTS.md addition so the assistant adapts to how you actually work. All processing happens on your machine — no data leaves it.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my Codex history and personalize how you work with me.
Show what you have learned about my working preferences.
Refresh my Vardoger personalization from recent conversations.
